name: Bhakoot (Rashi) Koota
citation: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra Chapter 81 Slokas 22-25; Muhurtha Chintamani; Jataka Deshamarga
description: Evaluates emotional closeness, wealth accumulation, progeny welfare, and relational harmony through Moon sign relative positions.

2_12.description: 2nd and 12th relative placement, potential financial expenditure or discord

5_9.description: 5th and 9th relative placement, potential progeny challenges or philosophical difference

6_8.description: 6th and 8th relative placement, potential health strain or ego friction

cancellation_rules.name: Same Rashi Lord
cancellation_rules.description: Bhakoot dosha is completely nullified if both signs are ruled by the same planetary lord (Aries-Scorpio ruled by Mars, Taurus-Libra ruled by Venus, Capricorn-Aquarius ruled by Saturn).

cancellation_rules.name: Mutual Friendship of Rashi Lords
cancellation_rules.description: Bhakoot dosha is nullified when the planetary rulers of both Moon signs are natural mutual friends.

cancellation_rules.name: Navamsa Lord Friendship
cancellation_rules.description: Bhakoot dosha is neutralized if Moon Navamsa lords of both partners are friends or identical.

cancellation_rules.name: Full Nadi and Graha Maitri Support
cancellation_rules.description: Tradition claim that if Nadi (8/8) and Graha Maitri (5/5) are auspicious, Bhakoot dosha loses harmful efficacy (unverified; traditions differ).
